project_type: Turborepo monorepo (npm workspaces): Fastify TypeScript API (apps/api), Prisma data package (packages/db), shared catalogues (packages/shared). ERP platform (CAMPASS) on top of a live GatePass app.
language: TypeScript on Node (ESM, "type": "module"; imports use .js specifiers).
build_system: npm workspaces + Turborepo (NOT pnpm). Quirks: @campusgate/shared must be rebuilt (cd packages/shared && npx tsc) so its dist is current BEFORE apps/api and packages/db/seed consume new catalogue keys. Prisma client is generated from repo root: npx prisma generate --schema=packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma. Prisma is pinned at 6.19.3 — do NOT upgrade to the 8.x RC the deploy log advertises. Build-time @types/* belong in dependencies (not devDependencies), per apps/api/package.json.
test_framework: Vitest (apps/api). apps/api/vitest.config includes src/**/*.test.ts only; packages/shared has no runner, so shared-catalogue tests live under apps/api/src/services/__tests__. Real-DB suites (escape, calendar/route integration) hit live Supabase and read apps/api/.env + packages/db/.env.
build_command: From repo root, in order: npm ci; (cd packages/shared && npx tsc); npx prisma generate --schema=packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma; (cd apps/api && npx tsc); npm run build
test_command: cd apps/api && npx vitest run   (single file: npx vitest run <path>)
verification_instructions: After each FEAT: rebuild shared if it changed, regenerate the Prisma client if the schema changed, then `cd apps/api && npx tsc` must compile clean, then run the FEAT's targeted vitest files. Final FEAT runs the full CLEAN build sequence + full `npx vitest run` and must be all green. Migration is authored create-only (cd packages/db && npx prisma migrate dev --create-only --name phase1_academics), hand-edited, then applied with npx prisma migrate deploy (uses DIRECT_URL). NEVER run plain `prisma migrate dev` against shared Supabase. Retry transient pooler errors (P1001 / 'tenant or user not found' / 'Can't reach database server') — the free tier pauses on inactivity. If migrate deploy reports drift, STOP and diagnose; do not force-reset the shared DB.
snapshot_or_generated_files: The Prisma client under node_modules/.prisma + @prisma/client is regenerated by `prisma generate` (not committed). The migration directory packages/db/prisma/migrations/<ts>_phase1_academics/migration.sql IS committed. No other generated-and-checked-in artifacts.
environment_constraints: Work on main, NO git worktree. Do NOT push or deploy. NEVER stage or modify apps/api/.env or packages/db/.env (live Supabase secrets needed by the escape suite). Shared Supabase DB is live — the migration is additive and the six existing migrations are FROZEN (never edited). campass_app role stays NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS — never grant BYPASSRLS.
contribution_requirements: Phase completion gate (docs/roadmap.md): per-module DoD passes; the cross-tenant escape suite is EXTENDED to every new table (incl. the deliberately-buggy-query test) and passes; new permissions registered in the catalogue AND bound to template roles; important actions write AuditLog v2 (audit_events via recordAuditEvent); schema changes shipped as versioned migrations with RLS/FKs in the SAME migration. Commit specific files only; never commit .env.
key_patterns: Tenancy (docs/tenancy.md §4): every tenant-owned table carries institutionId + @@unique([id, institutionId]) + @@index([institutionId]); cross-tenant links use composite FKs INCLUDING institutionId (migration drops Prisma's single-col FK and re-adds the composite), ON DELETE RESTRICT for ownership, SET NULL for informational links. RLS house style (superadmin_security/module_system migrations): DO $$ ENABLE+FORCE then nullif(current_setting('app.current_institution_id', true), '')-guarded fail-closed policies; standard pair = tenant_isolation_select (FOR SELECT) + tenant_isolation_modify (FOR ALL); append-only pair (audit_events) = tenant_isolation_select + <table>_tenant_insert (FOR INSERT) with NO modify policy, plus REVOKE UPDATE,DELETE from campass_app and a BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger (function <t>_append_only() raising restrict_violation + trigger <t>_no_update_delete) binding every role. GRANT refresh guarded by IF EXISTS (pg_roles ... 'campass_app'). Catalogue-sync meta-test parses the migration's INSERT INTO "permissions" ... ON CONFLICT and INSERT INTO "role_permissions" ... AS m( blocks and unions across SEEDING_MIGRATION_DIRS — new permissions must be seeded with those exact markers AND the new migration dir added to that array. recordAuditEvent(input, tx) writes inside the withTenant tx for tenant actions; action keys validated against AUDIT_ACTION_KEY_SET (no enum/migration mirror). withTenant(institutionId, fn) pins the tenant GUC transaction-locally; tenant reads/writes MUST go through it. Services take a passed Prisma.TransactionClient/DbClient and keep transition/precedence logic as pure functions for DB-free unit tests (see module-system.ts). admin.ts routes: requirePermission(...) preHandler + withTenant + recordAuditEvent in-tx; academics routes are permission-gated ONLY (NO requireModuleActive — Decision A).
directory_structure: packages/shared/src: permissions.ts (PERMISSIONS + ROLE_PERMISSIONS + PermissionKey), audit-actions.ts (AUDIT_ACTIONS + AUDIT_ACTION_KEY_SET + LEGACY_AUDIT_ACTION_MAP), validation.ts (zod schemas), modules.ts (module registry/deps — FROZEN for this task), index.ts (barrel). packages/db: prisma/schema.prisma (all models/enums), prisma/migrations/<ts>_* (6 FROZEN dirs + the new one), src/index.ts (prisma/privilegedPrisma/withTenant/breakGlassPrisma/DbClient), src/seed.ts (demo institution; courses incl. BCA code 512 captured in `bca`, B.Tech-CSE code 501). apps/api/src: middleware/auth.ts (authenticate + RequestAuth), services/ (authz-engine, audit, allowance-engine, module-system, calendar-service [NEW], academic-session [NEW]), routes/ (admin.ts, student.ts, hod.ts, guard.ts, platform.ts), routes/__tests__/ (escape suite + helpers + integration tests), services/__tests__/ (catalogue-sync, audit-actions, authz-engine, modules).
